title: What to pack for the maternity hospital
what: This is a list of things to take to the maternity hospital for you and your baby. It is best to pack your bag ahead of time.
why: The bag is usually packed by 36 weeks, or earlier if there is a risk of early birth.
duration: packing usually takes one evening; the bag is for 2 to 5 days
tell_doctor: If you need special things because of your health conditions
If a cesarean section is planned

prepare.title: Documents
prepare.text: Your ID, your pregnancy record, and your insurance or referral, if needed.

prepare.title: For you
prepare.text: A robe, a nightgown, slippers, underwear, pads, toiletries, and a phone charger.

prepare.title: For your baby
prepare.text: Newborn diapers, clothes, a hat, socks, and clothes for going home that suit the season.

prepare.title: Hospital rules
prepare.text: Get your hospital's list ahead of time: what you can and cannot bring.

bring: Your regular medicines and a list of them
steps: Pack things into three bags: for the delivery room, for your room, and for going home
Put your documents in a separate folder
Put the bag by the door
Tell your family where it is
feel: Packing helps you feel calmer, with less rush when labor starts
after: You can leave the going-home things at home. Someone can bring them
Before you leave, check your documents and phone
red_flags: Regular contractions, leaking fluid, or bleeding: go to the maternity hospital or call emergency services
Your baby is moving much less

faq.q: When should I pack my bag?
faq.a: Usually by 36 weeks. If your doctor mentions a risk of early birth, earlier.

faq.q: What is most important to bring?
faq.a: Your documents and pregnancy record. Your family can bring the rest.

reminders.text: Check your hospital bag: documents, pregnancy record, things for you and your baby.
